mechanism: Hypothesis was that removing tl.trans would cut shared-memory layout-conversion scratch. REFUTED in direction: shared memory rose 45056->66096 and registers rose 137->159 while inst_executed fell only 1.6%. The real effect is removal of a serialization point -- each tl.trans forced a full tile to materialize before its dependent tl.dot could issue, so deleting them let the compiler stage deeper and overlap loads with math (sm__throughput 3.63->4.95%, dram 5.59->7.74%). Spending registers/shared memory is free in this regime because occupancy is not the limiter (0.105 waves/SM, ~2/3 of SMs idle).
